records.subset_statement: Thompson Section 3 explicitly identifies the original 1,322 Conkin records and one exclusion for statistical influence. The reported uncensored count falls from 168 to 167 and the right-censored count remains 1,154. Conkin identifies two contributing centers and Thompson describes JSC. The site assignment of individual records is unavailable.
records.note: The margins differ by one uncensored record in the male and no-repetitive-exercise strata. This is a comparison of published aggregate counts. The identity of the observation is unavailable.
